teach_en: Every Lao word has a melody: your voice rises, falls or stays level as you say it. The line next to each word is a picture of that melody: high or low, rising, falling or level. ຂາວ (white) and ລາວ (he, she) differ in their first sound and in their melody. The other two pairs have exactly the same sounds and differ only in melody, and that alone makes them different words. Play each word and copy its melody. Why a word has its melody depends on its letters and marks; you will see how later. For now, learn each word's melody with the word. || W000538 || W000031 || W000019 || W000724 || W000025 || W000562

teach_en: The same mark ◌້ sits on ເຂົ້າ (rice) and on ນ້ຳ (water), but their melodies are different. A mark does not give one fixed melody, so listen to each word and learn its melody with it. || W000019 || W000011 || W000562
